record.question: He cried as though he was ruined.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. “As though he was ruined” describes how he cried, an adverb clause (B). Independent check: “As though he was ruined” is a subordinate clause comparing the manner/circumstance of his crying; it functions adverbially.
